metadata.title: ESMfluc: trained models for Protein Block variability prediction and signed contribution analysis
metadata.notes: The ESMfluc code and both the ESM2-based and ESM3-based weight families are released under MIT, with upstream copyright and license notices retained. ESM3 upstream provenance: biohub/esm3-sm-open-v1, revision 47f0545b2b6daf26a93439a3cd610f4f7f3d5478, file data/weights/esm3_sm_open_v1.pth, SHA-256 5ead5a135c658068db6a4f1b933e72d6110992c4668822e1c0e2dcc53e38acd9. On 2026-10-23, the local cached file checksum was verified against the official file metadata at that revision, whose model card specifies MIT. This identifies the upstream file for licensing provenance; it does not establish a recorded training-time revision. Third-party software and data retain their own terms.
metadata.description: Trained ESMfluc model weights for residue-level single-PB versus multi-PB classification and exact signed-contribution analysis. Includes seven model conditions with three independent training seeds each: ESM2 and ESM3 frozen, top-four and top-28 fine-tuned BiLSTM--attention models, plus the frozen ESM2 linear baseline. Shared backbone tensors and seed-specific overrides reconstruct all 21 original checkpoints without quantization or precision conversion. Includes training arguments, class definitions, band-detection settings, checksums, a checkpoint loader and environment/source metadata used by the ESMfluc Colab notebook. Contributions describe the model's final calculation and do not establish causal biological interactions. Built with ESM.
